en: A color-printed postcard reproducing a medieval-style mural or fresco showing a royal or imperial ceremony. Under a richly decorated Gothic arch, a crowned ruler and nobles stand on a terrace while clergy in ornate vestments officiate. Numerous courtiers, flag bearers, and attendants fill the scene, some holding banners with heraldic symbols. In the foreground are steps where common people, including a kneeling woman with a child and flowers, look up at the ceremony. Behind them rise castle-like towers and city walls, suggesting a European medieval city. The whole image is framed architecturally, as if the viewer is looking at a wall painting inside a Gothic building. Any inscriptions in the painted base are too small to be read clearly.
